title: Cyber-security knowledge base (defensive folders)

license.note: The dataset card is tagged apache-2.0, but its LICENSE file says the material was gathered from many platforms and scraped documents under a fair-use claim. The upstream rights are not confirmed.
license.use: Internal diagnostic reference on the owner's own machine. Not redistributed, not bundled in an installer, not served from the site.

excludeNote: Every folder not listed in include is left out. That covers the attack-side folders (offensive-security, red-team, penetration-testing, malware, ransomware, botnet-ddos, social-engineering, phishing and the rest) and the loose files at the top of the dataset. Add a folder name to include to bring it in.

route.description: Security diagnostics: detection, hardening, incident response, forensics, identity and access, cloud and container security, compliance and vulnerability reference. Added by Kingmaker from catalog/corpora/security-diagnostics.json; the shard exists only after the owner fetches the corpus.
